name: Blinds
author: E. T. Carter
description: Vertical fabric blinds hanging in front of a lit window. Each slat is a curved surface rotated on its hanging axis, shaded with wrapped diffuse, a satin band and window light bleeding through the cloth, its lit edge rimmed bright and its far edge sinking into a dark seam, while the slat in front lays a soft contact shadow on the one behind. Through the gaps a luminous colour field drifts and wraps its light onto the slat edges. A wave of tilt travels along the run so the blinds open and close in a slow ripple as a draft sways them.

params.label: Slats
params.effect: Slats across the frame width; low is a few broad panels, high is a fine run of narrow slats.

params.label: Tilt
params.effect: Base opening of the blinds; 0 hangs the slats face-on and nearly shut, 1 turns them edge-on so the window floods through.

params.label: Curve
params.effect: Curvature of each slat; 0 is a flat strip, high is a deep channel with a strong shading gradient.

params.label: Window light
params.effect: How much window light comes through the cloth and wraps around the slat edges.

params.label: Sway
params.effect: Speed of the tilt wave, the draft sway and the drift of the light behind; 0 holds the blinds still.
